title: CDC & FDA Antimicrobial Resistance Isolate Bank: Rapid Panel Target Crosswalk
description: An open crosswalk of the CDC & FDA Antimicrobial Resistance Isolate Bank. For every isolate in every panel it lists the resistance genes CDC reports, the NCBI BioSample accession and CDC's posted reference broth microdilution results, and maps each isolate to the resistance targets of seven FDA-cleared rapid blood culture panels (BioFire BCID2; ePlex BCID-GP and BCID-GN; Verigene BC-GP and BC-GN; LIAISON PLEX Gram-positive and Gram-negative). Gene names are grouped into targets with the NCBI AMRFinderPlus Reference Gene Hierarchy. Hard cases, where genotype and phenotype part ways, are flagged so laboratories can choose verification organisms under 42 CFR 493.1253. The release also contains an external check of the U.S. Rapid Panel Resistance Marker Concordance Benchmark against the Bank's reference results, NCBI AMRFinderPlus calls for Bank genomes, the code, a QA report and a provenance log fingerprinting every downloaded page. Data accessed 2026-10-24. Not affiliated with or endorsed by CDC, FDA or any manufacturer.
